title: Deciding answer
description: What an agent answers start-audit ID --open-findings with: the request's id and basis, then a decision per open finding it names, giving only the fields that change and a one-line reason. A field left out keeps its value. Fields this tool does not read are refused. Models::FindingDecision checks each decision.

decision_fields.description: The note start-audit ID --open-findings --as template prints at its head naming each field a decision may give and what it means, which an answer may send back and Models::OpenFindingsDecision ignores, whatever it holds.

x-type-refusal-advice.says: with path, plus starting_at (or heading) when the file holds more than this finding, or with url alone, a whole https link, for a write-up outside the project such as an issue
